description: Source code defining load balancer classes for tensor sharding in distributed attention, including strategies like head-tail, per-document, and processing-time round-robin load balancing.

classes.name: _LoadBalancer
classes.description: Abstract base class for load balancing strategies in tensor sharding.

classes.name: _HeadTailLoadBalancer
classes.description: Implements head-and-tail load balancing for sequence tensors.

classes.name: _PerDocumentHeadTailLoadBalancer
classes.description: Implements per-document head-and-tail load balancing for variable-length sequences.

classes.name: _PTRRLoadBalancer
classes.description: Implements processing-time based round-robin load balancing leveraging BlockMask.

methods.name: _generate_indices
methods.description: Abstract method to generate load balancing indices or restore indices, implemented differently in subclasses.

methods.name: _generate_indices_for_batch
methods.description: Generates load balancing indices for a batch of variable-length sequences in per-document load balancing.

methods.name: ptrr_scheduling
methods.description: Static method to perform task grouping based on process time for round-robin scheduling.

methods.name: _create_default_load_balancer
methods.description: Factory function to create a default load balancer based on options.
